description: This file contains a utility class `RandomUtilities` with static methods and constants for generating random values and identifiers used in Orleans storage tests. It defines methods for generating random GUIDs, integers, longs, strings, grain IDs, and symbols, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: RandomUtilities
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to generate random values for tests in Orleans storage context.

methods.name: GetRandom
methods.description: Returns a random value of the specified type T, optionally within a given range.

methods.name: GetRandomCharacters
methods.description: Generates a random string of characters from a specified SymbolSet and length.

methods.name: GetRandomGrainId
methods.description: Generates a random GrainId based on the specified type and optional key extension.
